entries.title: Marks replaces Braelon; the shared Puka assumption needs rechecking
entries.question: Which conditional RB workload is better supported now, and do Noel/Dell or CMC/Kittle/Kirk justify adopting Claude’s full allocation?
entries.why_it_matters: An availability premise changed overnight, while both starting drafts retain an expensive receiver with a new calf issue. Salary savings and model revisions must remain distinct.
findings: Hall returned to LP Thursday; Montgomery remained DNP. Neither is a final game designation.
Marks’ official log shows15 carries in each of the last two games, with4then2catches. This supports opportunity, not guaranteed efficiency or TDs.
Dell was FP both days. No inspected forward Noel route share resolves competition from Dell/Harrison.
SF table shows Evans/Deebo DNP and Kirk FP; activation and target allocation remain unresolved.
Puka newly calfLP and exportQ; his old healthy-role assumption cannot silently survive into freeze.
Baker FP/Egbuka DNP and Godwin restDNP; Keenan ThursdayFP. No automatic target transfer is assumed.
entries.interpretation: Select Marks provisionally and preserve eight holds. Decline the full Noel-funded allocation for now; CMC/Kittle remains an unresolved alternative. Puka’s Friday participation is more consequential than forcing a second daily swap.
alternatives: Braelon can return to consideration if Hall is ruled out; Montgomery return weakens Marks.
Reproducing Claude’s five remaining differences costs net+$300 and reaches$50,000. Noel’s$2,900 saving versusNabers funds much of the Goff/CMC/Kittle/Jets package.
Puka worsening before cutoff requires a fresh whole-lineup alternative; cheap Rams players do not automatically inherit his targets.
uncertainty: Puka severity and Friday participation/final status unknown.
Neither Montgomery nor Hall has a final designation in inspected Thursday tables.
Dell/Kirk FP does not prove activation, unrestricted routes or exact target distribution; export stillIR.
CMC/Kittle target premise may strengthen with Evans/Deebo absence, but Kirk is also a competing return.
Model asofOct22morning predates materialThursdaynews;138.8 is attributed baseline, not an injury-adjusted Codex forecast.

entries.lineup_effect: Braelon→Marks (-$300), total$49,700/$300left. Stroud/Marks plus opposingNabers increases shared Houston-game exposure; rushing/passTD allocation can offset benefits. Current same-model swap effect+0.1; forecast refresh+0.7, total138.8. No historical estimates overwritten.
change_triggers: Puka worsening/absence before cutoff requires reconsidering the expensive WR slot; do not assume cheap Rams replacements inherit his production.
Montgomery return weakens Marks; final Hall absence reopensBraelon.
Qualified Dell/Noel routes and SF activation/role evidence can change whole packages beforefreeze.
carry_forward: Prioritize Puka’s Friday calf participation/severity before freeze; model timestamp predates that news.
Resolve Montgomery/Hall final status; practice progress is evidence, not a binary availability verdict.
Require actual forward-role evidence for Noel/Dell and SF returning receivers before treating cheap prices as secured opportunity.
Preserve both original drafts for Grok’s actual question pass; daily changes should not restart v1.
A shared final needs substantive Claude/Codex revision contributions. Missing Grok or Claude response must be labelled and cannot extend Sunday’s cutoff.
